statusText: Tail low; Stress high as the technology rebound continues without verified persistent one-way NQ structure.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains below WATCH; the next concentrated danger window is the August 26 U.S. macro cluster.
headline: Tech rebound keeps Tail low while the August 26 macro cluster lifts Stress
body: Technology shares are rebounding with positive breadth and lower Treasury yields, but available public evidence does not establish persistent no-retracement Nasdaq-100 structure. Tail remains low; Stress is high ahead of GDP, PCE and durable-goods releases.

sources.title: Reuters: Wall St rebounds on tech revival
Reuters: Nvidia options imply large earnings swing
University of Michigan Surveys of Consumers

lookbackSummary: Tail rose into an elevated downside-path episode Monday, then fell below 20 overnight and remained low into Tuesday; the 06:00 UTC slot has no published assessment.
outlookSummary: Tail remains low unless persistent one-way structure emerges. Stress rises sharply into the August 26 12:30 UTC GDP/PCE/durable-goods cluster, treated as event/whipsaw risk rather than an assumed directional break.

forecast.analysis: Observed tech rebound, positive breadth and lower yields support a mixed regime; no verified persistent one-way NQ path is evident, so Tail remains low while Stress stays high.

news.title: Wall St rebounds on tech revival ahead of Nvidia results, inflation data

forecast.analysis: Cash-session follow-through remains the checkpoint: Tail stays low unless pullbacks become shallow and repeated upside extension develops; Stress eases modestly from the current peak.
Later cash trading remains conditionally mixed; a failure of retracements with semis and megacaps aligned would raise Tail, while ordinary two-way rotation would keep it low.
Into the late U.S. session, directional persistence rather than headline importance is the key Tail test; Stress continues to ease if price discovery remains orderly.
Power-hour risk is elevated only if the rebound turns into repeated extension near session extremes; otherwise the expected regime remains mixed with low Tail.

news.title: Nvidia shares set for $280 billion price swing after earnings, options show

forecast.analysis: Near the cash close, Tail stays low absent a one-way closing auction or failed pullbacks; Nvidia positioning can keep Stress elevated without implying a pathological path.
drivers: Nvidia earnings positioning remains a volatility amplifier

forecast.analysis: Early evening liquidity is thinner; headline sensitivity rises, but Tail remains low unless a sustained directional sequence emerges in NQ futures.
Overnight transition favors a normal baseline. Conditional Tail risk remains low, with geopolitical or rates shocks the main reasons for a sudden regime change.
Asia-hours liquidity can amplify isolated moves, but no future directional path is assumed; Stress is moderate and Tail stays low without repeated extension.
Overnight structure remains conditional and normal; meaningful retracements would validate low Tail, while an unusually efficient trend would be the principal invalidation.
Mid-Asia trading retains a normal baseline. Cross-asset confirmation would matter only if a directional NQ move also becomes persistent and retracement-poor.
drivers: Cross-asset alignment only matters with persistent NQ direction

forecast.analysis: Late Asia hours remain low-Tail under ordinary two-way trade; Stress begins to rebuild gradually as the next U.S. macro cluster approaches.
European pre-open sensitivity rises slightly. Tail remains low unless rates and equity futures align with a persistent directional move rather than a transient gap.
European morning trading is a conditional transition window; orderly retracements keep Tail low, while repeated extension would raise the path-risk assessment.
Approaching U.S. premarket, Stress rises as GDP, PCE and durable-goods releases near; event importance alone does not imply a Tail block.
drivers: GDP, PCE and durable-goods releases approaching
Event risk raises Stress more than Tail

forecast.analysis: Premarket positioning can become more fragile ahead of the 12:30 UTC data cluster; Tail remains low unless a one-way move is already becoming persistent.
drivers: Premarket positioning ahead of 12:30 UTC data

forecast.analysis: Two hours before the macro cluster, forecast uncertainty increases. Stress is elevated, but Tail remains low because no future surprise or price reaction is assumed.
drivers: Two hours to U.S. macro cluster

forecast.analysis: One hour before the releases, event/whipsaw risk becomes material. Tail still depends on observed directional efficiency, not on the existence of the scheduled data.
Immediately ahead of the 12:30 UTC macro cluster, Stress is very high. Conditional Tail risk rises only modestly unless pre-release NQ develops shallow pullbacks and repeated extension.
At 10:00 UTC, high-stress pre-release positioning dominates. Tail remains below WATCH unless a persistent pre-data directional sequence develops.
At 11:00 UTC, the final hour before the 12:30 UTC macro cluster carries very high Stress; future release outcomes and market reactions remain unknown.
The 12:00 UTC hour contains the 12:30 UTC GDP, PCE and durable-goods cluster. WATCH is conditional path risk, not an assumed surprise or directional break.
At 13:00 UTC, post-release price discovery is the key test: WATCH persists only if repricing is directional with failed retracements; orderly two-way trade would lower Tail.
By 14:00 UTC, post-data structure should be clearer. Tail is forecast below WATCH if retracements occur and cross-assets stabilize; persistent extension would invalidate that path.
drivers: Stress decay if price discovery is orderly
